annotations.title: List the electric utilities we cover in a state

description: Use this when someone asks which electric utilities or Texas delivery companies we have plans for in a state, or when you need the exact utility name to pass to electricity_search_plans or electricity_get_price_to_compare. Returns each utility with its current plan count, the newest data date, whether a price to compare is held, and the other names electricity_find_utility_by_zip may use for it (zip_lookup_names). Do not use it to find the utility for a ZIP code (use electricity_find_utility_by_zip). `status` `no_data_for_scope` means we hold no utilities for that state, never that it has none.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. 'TX', 'OH'. Required.

name: electricity_list_utilities
